headline: FLSmidth Names Sander Fynboe as Interim Chief Financial Officer
summary: Danish industrial group FLSmidth appointed Sander Fynboe as interim CFO with immediate effect while the company conducts a executive search.
why: FLSmidth is a global engineering firm supplying equipment and services to the mining and cement industries.

impacts.why: FLSmidth named Sander Fynboe to serve as interim CFO.
